rows.name: scene-ford
rows.prompt: Image 1 is a rough flat colour sketch of the layout: keep exactly its layout - the dirt road coming from the near foreground straight down the grassy bank, going INTO the creek, crossing through the shallow rippling water to the other side and climbing the far bank into the trees. Image 2 is the style reference: match its palette, its detailed hand-painted brushwork and the look of its oaks, grass and rutted road, but paint even midday light instead of its sunset. Paint a new wide landscape picture: a rutted dirt wagon road at a shallow ford across a slow clear Texas creek, the wheel ruts running into the water and out on the far bank, tall cottonwoods and bald cypress along the far side. Seen from eye level with the camera slightly raised. The horizon sits one third of the way down the picture, under a wide summer sky with soft white clouds. The middle of the picture and the near foreground are open, empty ground with nothing tall in them. Even, mild daylight with soft short shadows, no sunset. Hand-painted storybook game art for a warm illustrated 1830s Texas frontier game: warm detailed gouache and oil brushwork, muted warm earth palette. No people, no animals, no wagons, no lettering on any building, no text, no signature, no watermark.

flags.scene-ford: the crossing is a shallow rippled band straight across, a little like a paved low-water crossing; s4 and s8 kept the road dry through the creek (a causeway) and s1 drew a bridge
